description:
Converts text to WIA Braille, a pronunciation-based common braille (NOT an official national braille code). Returns IPA and braille cells (6-dot paper form or 8-dot canonical form), plus quality/confidence. Low-quality results are flagged, not hidden.
한국어: 텍스트를 발음 기반 WIA 점자로 변환합니다(국가 공식 점자 아님).

lang.description: ISO language code, e.g. ko, en, ja. If omitted the API auto-detects; call braille_languages for supported codes

name: braille_convert
title: Text to WIA Braille (pronunciation-based)
